title: Knowledge That Informs
description: Peer-reviewed research, policy briefs, and thought leadership publications that shape global discourse on development and governance.

cards.title: The Future of Sovereign Debt
cards.description: A comprehensive policy brief on restructuring mechanisms and debt sustainability in the post-pandemic era.
cards.abstract: This brief examines emerging sovereign debt challenges and proposes a framework for orderly restructuring that balances creditor rights with debtor development needs.

cards.title: Digital ID and Financial Inclusion
cards.description: Research paper on how national digital identity systems accelerate financial inclusion outcomes.
cards.abstract: Using panel data from 45 countries, this paper quantifies the causal impact of digital ID deployment on financial account ownership and credit access.
takeaways: Digital ID increases account ownership by 23%
Effects strongest for women and rural populations

cards.title: Rwanda PFM Reform Journey
cards.description: Case study documenting Rwanda's two-decade public financial management transformation and lessons for others.
cards.abstract: This case study traces Rwanda's PFM reform from post-conflict reconstruction to becoming a regional leader in budget credibility and audit quality.
takeaways: Political commitment was the critical success factor

cards.title: Green Bonds in Emerging Markets
cards.description: Working paper analyzing the growth, pricing, and impact of sovereign and corporate green bonds in developing economies.
cards.abstract: We analyze 340 green bond issuances from emerging markets, examining pricing dynamics, use of proceeds, and verified environmental outcomes.

cards.title: Adapting to Climate Reality
cards.description: Policy brief on scaling adaptation finance through innovative instruments and public-private partnerships.
cards.abstract: With adaptation finance falling far short of needs, this brief identifies scalable instruments and partnership models to close the gap.
takeaways: Blended finance can unlock 4x private capital
Local currency instruments reduce FX risk

cards.title: AI in Public Service Delivery
cards.description: Research paper examining the opportunities, risks, and governance requirements for AI adoption in government services.
cards.abstract: Based on interviews with 80 government CIOs and analysis of 200 AI deployments, this paper maps the state of AI in public services.
takeaways: Chatbots reduced service wait times by 60%
